newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Sanwei plans IPO of 70 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: China's Sanwei plans IPO of 70 mln A shares.

text.p: China's Sanwei (Group) Co Ltd, a chemical fibre producer, is planning to launch an initial public offering of 70 million A shares at a tentative price of 5.9 yuan each, a company official said on Friday.
The proceeds will be used to boost production capacity, especially in polyester, he told the Hong Kong-based China Securities Bulletin.
The official said the company had not yet decided where it would list the shares or who the chief underwriter would be.
The company has applied to list 150 million B shares but has not yet received approval from the China Securities Regulatory Commission, he said.
Sanwei has a total of 120 million shares, made up of 112 million state shares and eight million staff shares, said the official.

The company, based in the city of Hongtong in the northern province of Shanxi, expects to earn net profits of about 50 million yuan in 1996, roughly the same as 1995 and 10 million more than 1994, he said.
